title.zh: 卷105之二 天象志一之二
title.raw: 卷105之二 天象志一之二 Volume 105b Treatise 1: Celestial Phenomena 2

sentences.zh: 太祖皇始二年六月庚戌，月掩太白，在端門外。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of Huangshi 2, on gengxu, during Taizu, the moon occulted Venus outside the Duan Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Huangshi 2, on gengxu day, during the reign of Taizu, the moon occulted Venus outside the Duan Gate asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "The state will suffer military attack."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "The state will suffer from warfare."

sentences.zh: 九月，慕容賀驎率三萬餘人出寇新市。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Murong Helin led more than thirty thousand men out to raid Xinshi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Murong Helin led over thirty thousand men in a raid on Xinshi.

sentences.zh: 十月，太祖破之於義臺塢，斬首九千餘級。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Taizu defeated them at Yitaiwu and cut off more than nine thousand heads.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Taizu routed them at Yitaiwu and took more than nine thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 天興元年十一月丁丑，月犯東上相。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of Tianxing 1, on dingchou, the moon trespassed against the Eastern Upper Minister star.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Tianxing 1, on dingchou, the moon trespassed against the Eastern Upper Minister asterism.

sentences.zh: 二年五月辛酉，月掩東上相。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year, on xinyou, the moon occulted the Eastern Upper Minister star.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year, on xinyou, the moon occulted the Eastern Upper Minister asterism.

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on renchen, the moon trespassed against Ox Leader.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renchen, the moon trespassed against the Ox Leader asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "The state will have anxiety."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "The state will face grave concern."

sentences.zh: 三年二月丁亥，皇子聰薨。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year, on dinghai, the imperial prince Cong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year, on dinghai, Prince Cong died.

sentences.zh: 三年三月乙丑，月犯鎮星，在牽牛。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year, on jiazi, the moon trespassed against the Queller Star in Ox Leader.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year, on jiazi, the moon trespassed against Saturn in the Ox Leader asterism.

sentences.zh: 七月己未，月犯鎮星，在牽牛。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on jiwei, the moon trespassed against the Queller Star in Ox Leader.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jiwei, the moon trespassed against Saturn in the Ox Leader asterism.

translations.literal: On xinyou, the moon trespassed against the Weeping Star.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the moon trespassed against the Weeping Star.

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year, on jiazi, the moon grew horns.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourth year, on jiazi, the moon showed horns.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "There will be a treacherous minister."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "A treacherous minister will appear."

sentences.zh: 五年十一月，秀容胡帥、前平原太守劉曜聚眾為盜，遣騎誅之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the fifth year, the Xiu Rong Hu commander and former Administrator of Pingyuan Liu Yao gathered a band as robbers; cavalry was sent to execute them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the fifth year, Liu Yao, a Xiu Rong chieftain and former prefect of Pingyuan, raised a band of brigands; the court sent cavalry to put them down.

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on dingmao, the moon trespassed against Heavenly Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on dingmao, the moon trespassed against the Heavenly Pass asterism.

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on jiazi, the moon trespassed against the Eastern Second Minister star.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jiazi, the moon trespassed against the Eastern Second Minister asterism.

sentences.zh: 五年四月辛丑，月掩辰星，在東井。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fifth year, on xinchou, the moon occulted Mercury in Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fifth year, on xinchou, the moon occulted Mercury in the Eastern Well asterism.

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on bingshen, the moon trespassed against Supreme Subtlety.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingshen, the moon trespassed against the Supreme Subtlety enclosure.

sentences.zh: 七月己亥，月犯歲星，在左角。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on jihai, the moon trespassed against Jupiter in the Left Horn.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jihai, the moon trespassed against Jupiter in the Left Horn asterism.

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on wushen, the moon haloed the Left Horn.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on wushen, a lunar halo ringed the Left Horn asterism.

sentences.zh: 時帝討姚興弟平於乾壁，克之。

translations.literal: At that time the emperor attacked Yao Xing's younger brother Ping at Ganbi and took it.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the emperor besieged Yao Xing's younger brother Ping at Ganbi and captured the city.

sentences.zh: 太史令晁崇奏角蟲將死，上慮牛疫，乃命諸軍併重焚車。

translations.literal: The Director of Astronomy Chao Chong reported that horned creatures would die; the emperor feared bovine pestilence and therefore ordered all armies to double-load and burn their wagons.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Astronomy Chao Chong reported that horned creatures would perish; fearing cattle plague, the emperor ordered every army to load its wagons doubly and burn them.

translations.literal: On bingxu, the imperial carriage turned north.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the imperial procession marched north.

sentences.zh: 牛大疫，死者十八九，官車所馭巨犗數百，同日斃於路側，首尾相屬。

translations.literal: A great cattle pestilence broke out; eight or nine in ten died. Several hundred great oxen harnessed to official wagons died the same day by the roadside, one after another in an unbroken line.
translations.idiomatic: Cattle plague swept the camps; eight or nine in ten perished. Several hundred draft oxen pulling official wagons died the same day along the road, their carcasses stretching end to end.

translations.literal: Elk and deer also died in great numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Elk and deer likewise died in great numbers.

translations.literal: On yimao, the moon trespassed against Supreme Subtlety.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the moon trespassed against the Supreme Subtlety enclosure.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "Noble persons will suffer anxiety."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "Persons of rank will face grave concern."

sentences.zh: 六年七月，鎮西大將軍、司隸校尉、毗陵王順有罪，以王還第。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the sixth year, the General Who Pacifies the West, Colonel-Director of Retainers, and Prince of Piling Shun was found guilty and sent back to his princely residence.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the sixth year, Shun, Prince of Piling, General Who Pacifies the West and Colonel-Director of Retainers, was found guilty and confined to his princely residence.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚申，月與太白同入羽林。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengshen, the moon and Venus together entered the Forest of Feathers.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengshen, the moon and Venus together entered the Forest of Feathers guard.

sentences.zh: 六年正月，月掩氐西南星。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year, the moon occulted the southwestern star of Root.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixth year, the moon occulted the southwestern star of the Root asterism.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，月掩北斗魁第四星。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiachen, the moon occulted the fourth star of the Northern Dipper's ladle head.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiachen, the moon occulted the fourth star of the Northern Dipper's bowl.

sentences.zh: 十月乙巳，月犯軒轅第四星。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on yisi, the moon trespassed against the fourth star of Chariot Axle.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on yisi, the moon trespassed against the fourth star of the Chariot Axle asterism.

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinsi, the moon trespassed against Mars.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinsi, the moon trespassed against Mars.

sentences.zh: 天賜元年二月甲辰，月掩歲星，在角。

translations.literal: In the second month of Tianci 1, on jiachen, the moon occulted Jupiter in the Horn.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Tianci 1, on jiachen, the moon occulted Jupiter in the Horn asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "Armies will rise throughout the realm."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "Warfare will break out across the realm."

sentences.zh: 三年四月，蠕蠕寇邊，夜召兵將，旦，賊走乃罷。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year, the Rouran raided the frontier. At night the emperor summoned generals; at dawn, when the bandits had fled, the summons was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year, the Rouran raided the borderlands. The emperor called up his generals by night; at dawn, once the enemy had withdrawn, he stood the army down.

sentences.zh: 四月甲午，月掩軒轅第四星。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on jiawu, the moon occulted the fourth star of Chariot Axle.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jiawu, the moon occulted the fourth star of the Chariot Axle asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "The chief consort will regard it with ill omen."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "The chief consort will take it as an ill sign."

sentences.zh: 六年七月，夫人劉氏薨，後諡宣穆皇后。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the sixth year, Lady Liu died; she was later given the posthumous title Empress Xuanmu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the sixth year, Lady Liu died; she was later posthumously titled Empress Xuanmu.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申，月掩斗魁第二星。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on renshen, the moon occulted the second star of the Dipper's ladle head.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renshen, the moon occulted the second star of the Dipper's bowl.

sentences.zh: 二年三月壬辰，月掩左執法。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year, on renchen, the moon occulted the Left Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year, on renchen, the moon occulted the Left Enforcer star.

translations.literal: On dingyou, the moon occulted the anterior star of Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the moon occulted the anterior star of the Heart asterism.

sentences.zh: 四月己卯，月犯鎮星，在東壁。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on jimao, the moon trespassed against the Queller Star in Eastern Wall.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jimao, the moon trespassed against Saturn in the Eastern Wall asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "A noble person will die."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "A person of rank will die."

sentences.zh: 四年五月，常山王遵有罪，賜死。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year, the Prince of Changshan Zun was found guilty and granted death.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fourth year, Zun, Prince of Changshan, was found guilty and ordered to take his own life.

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on jiwei, the moon occulted the Queller Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jiwei, the moon occulted Saturn.

sentences.zh: 八月丁巳，月犯斗第一星。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on dingsi, the moon trespassed against the first star of the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingsi, the moon trespassed against the first star of the Dipper asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "Great ministers will suffer anxiety."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "High ministers will face grave concern."

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year, Grand Commandant Mu Chong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year, Grand Commandant Mu Chong died.

sentences.zh: 十月丁巳，月掩鎮星，在營室。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on dingsi, the moon occulted the Queller Star in Encampment Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on dingsi, the moon occulted Saturn in the Encampment Hall asterism.

sentences.zh: 三年二月己丑，月犯心後星。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year, on jichou, the moon trespassed against the posterior star of Heart.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year, on jichou, the moon trespassed against the posterior star of the Heart asterism.

sentences.zh: 四月癸丑，月犯太微西上將。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on guichou, the moon trespassed against the Western Upper General of Supreme Subtlety.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on guichou, the moon trespassed against the Western Upper General star of the Supreme Subtlety enclosure.

translations.literal: On jiwei, the moon trespassed against the second southern star of Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the moon trespassed against the second southern star of the Chamber asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "Generals and chancellors will suffer anxiety."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "Generals and chief ministers will face grave concern."

sentences.zh: 四年五月，誅定陵公和跋。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year, the Duke of Dingling He Ba was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fourth year, He Ba, Duke of Dingling, was put to death.

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on guiwei, the moon trespassed against the Left Horn.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guiwei, the moon trespassed against the Left Horn asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "The General of the Left will die."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "The General of the Left will die."

sentences.zh: 六年三月，左將軍、曲陽侯元素延死。

translations.literal: In the third month of the sixth year, the General of the Left and Marquis of Quyang Yuan Su Yan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the sixth year, Yuan Su Yan, General of the Left and Marquis of Quyang, died.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午，月掩太白，在危。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on bingwu, the moon occulted Venus in Rooftop.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingwu, the moon occulted Venus in the Rooftop asterism.

sentences.zh: 四年二月庚申，月掩心後星。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year, on gengshen, the moon occulted the posterior star of Heart.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fourth year, on gengshen, the moon occulted the posterior star of the Heart asterism.

sentences.zh: 五年五月丁未，月掩斗第二星。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year, on dingwei, the moon occulted the second star of the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fifth year, on dingwei, the moon occulted the second star of the Dipper asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "The great man will suffer anxiety."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "The sovereign will face grave concern."

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the sixth year, on wuchen, Taizu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the sixth year, on wuchen, Taizu died.

sentences.zh: 太宗永興元年二月甲子，月犯昴。

translations.literal: In the second month of Yongxing 1, during Taizong, on jiazi, the moon trespassed against Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Yongxing 1, on jiazi, during the reign of Taizong, the moon trespassed against the Hairy Head asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰「胡不安，天子破匈奴」。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "The Hu will be unsettled; the Son of Heaven will break the Xiongnu."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "The northern peoples will be unsettled; the Son of Heaven will defeat the Xiongnu."

sentences.zh: 二年五月，太宗討蠕蠕社崘，社崘遁走。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year, Taizong attacked the Rouran khan She Lun; She Lun fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year, Taizong campaigned against the Rouran khan She Lun, who fled.

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renyin, the moon trespassed against Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renyin, the moon trespassed against the Hairy Head asterism.

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on dingyou, the moon trespassed against Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on dingyou, the moon trespassed against the Hairy Head asterism.

sentences.zh: 二年三月丁卯，月掩房南第二星，又掩斗第五星。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year, on dingmao, the moon occulted the second southern star of Chamber and also occulted the fifth star of the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year, on dingmao, the moon occulted the second southern star of Chamber and also occulted the fifth star of the Dipper.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子，月掩斗第五星。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jiazi, the moon occulted the fifth star of the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiazi, the moon occulted the fifth star of the Dipper asterism.

translations.literal: On jihai, the moon occulted Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the moon occulted the Hairy Head asterism.

sentences.zh: 六月己丑，月犯房南第二星。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jichou, the moon trespassed against the second southern star of Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jichou, the moon trespassed against the second southern star of the Chamber asterism.

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on yihai, the moon trespassed against the Ghost Carriage.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on yihai, the moon trespassed against the Ghost Carriage asterism.

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiashen, the moon trespassed against the anterior star of Heart.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiashen, the moon trespassed against the anterior star of the Heart asterism.

sentences.zh: 三年六月庚子，月犯歲星，在畢。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the third year, on gengzi, the moon trespassed against Jupiter in Net.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the third year, on gengzi, the moon trespassed against Jupiter in the Net asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "There will be frontier troops."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "There will be warfare on the borders."

sentences.zh: 五年四月，上黨民勞聰、士臻羣聚為盜，殺太守令長，相率外奔。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fifth year, the commoners of Shangdang Lao Cong and Shi Zhen gathered as bandits, killed the grand administrator and magistrates, and led one another in flight beyond the borders.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fifth year, Lao Cong and Shi Zhen of Shangdang raised a band of brigands, killed the prefect and county magistrates, and fled beyond the frontier in a body.

sentences.zh: 八月乙未，月犯歲星，在參。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on yiwei, the moon trespassed against Jupiter in Three Stars.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yiwei, the moon trespassed against Jupiter in the Three Stars asterism.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月壬戌，月行畢，蝕歲星。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fourth year, on renxu, the moon traversed Net and eclipsed Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the fourth year, on renxu, the moon passed through Net and eclipsed Jupiter.

translations.literal: On guihai, the moon occulted the second northern star of Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the moon occulted the second northern star of the Chamber asterism.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚申，月行昴，犯熒惑。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on gengshen, the moon traversed Hairy Head and trespassed against Mars.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on gengshen, the moon passed through Hairy Head and trespassed against Mars.

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the moon eclipsed Mars.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, the moon occulted Mars.

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on wushen, the moon trespassed against the Weeping Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wushen, the moon trespassed against the Weeping Star.

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on xinhai, the moon occulted Heavenly Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on xinhai, the moon occulted the Heavenly Pass asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "There will be troops."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "There will be warfare."

sentences.zh: 五年六月，濩澤民劉逸，自號征東將軍、三巴王，署置官屬，攻逼建興郡，元城侯元屈等討平之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fifth year, Liu Yi of Huoze styled himself General Who Pacifies the East and King of Three Ba, appointed officials, and pressed an attack on Jianxing Commandery; Yuan Qu, Marquis of Yuancheng, and others suppressed and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fifth year, Liu Yi of Huoze proclaimed himself General Who Pacifies the East and King of Three Ba, set up a court, and besieged Jianxing Commandery; Yuan Qu, Marquis of Yuancheng, and others put down the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 五年三月戊辰，月行參，犯太白。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fifth year, on wuchen, the moon traversed Three Stars and trespassed against Venus.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fifth year, on wuchen, the moon passed through Three Stars and trespassed against Venus.

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on guimao, the moon haloed Wings, Axletree, and Horn.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on guimao, a lunar halo ringed Wings, Axletree, and Horn.

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on gengwu, the moon occulted Hook and Latch.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on gengwu, the moon occulted the Hook and Latch asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "The throat-and-tongue ministers will suffer anxiety."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "The court spokesmen will face grave concern."

sentences.zh: 五年三月，散騎常侍王洛兒卒。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fifth year, the Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Wang Luo'er died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fifth year, Wang Luo'er, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, died.

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on gengshen, the moon trespassed against Venus.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengshen, the moon trespassed against Venus.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "Anxiety over troops."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "Anxiety over warfare."

sentences.zh: 神瑞元年二月，赫連屈丐入寇河東，殺掠吏民，三城護軍張昌等要擊走之。

translations.literal: In the second month of Shenrui 1, Helian Qugai invaded Hedong, killed and plundered officials and commoners; Zhang Chang, Protector of the Army of Sancheng, and others intercepted and drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Shenrui 1, Helian Qugai raided Hedong, killing and plundering officials and people; Zhang Chang, Protector of the Army of Sancheng, and others intercepted him and drove him off.

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jichou, the moon trespassed against the Left Horn.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jichou, the moon trespassed against the Left Horn asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "There will be troops throughout the realm."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "Warfare will arise throughout the realm."

sentences.zh: 神瑞元年十二月，蠕蠕犯塞。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of Shenrui 1, the Rouran violated the frontier passes.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Shenrui 1, the Rouran raided the border passes.

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on yisi, the moon trespassed against Net.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on yisi, the moon trespassed against the Net asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "Among the noble there will be deaths."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "Persons of rank will die."

sentences.zh: 泰常元年三月，長樂王處文薨。

translations.literal: In the third month of Taichang 1, the Prince of Changle Chuwene died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Taichang 1, Prince Chuwene of Changle died.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，月蝕房第一星。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on bingxu, the moon eclipsed the first star of Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingxu, the moon occulted the first star of the Chamber asterism.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰，月三暈東井。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiachen, the moon triple-haloed Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiachen, the moon formed a triple halo around the Eastern Well asterism.

sentences.zh: 神瑞元年正月丁卯，月犯畢。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year, Sima Wensi, Prince of Qiao under Sima Dezong, sent an envoy from Jiangdong to the court with a memorial requesting troops to attack Liu Yu; Taizong ordered Minister of Education Changgusun Song to lead the generals in intercepting him.

translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "The empress will face grave concern."

sentences.zh: 五年六月丁卯，貴嬪杜氏薨，後諡密皇后。

translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fifth year, on dingmao, Honored Consort Lady Du died; she was later posthumously honored as Empress Mi.

translations.idiomatic: Shizu ordered General Who Pacifies the West and Anding garrison commander Lu Si to campaign against him and take him captive.

sentences.zh: 三年三月癸未，月犯太白。

translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year, on guiwei, the moon trespassed against Venus.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "Anxiety over troops."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "Anxiety over warfare."

sentences.zh: 四年正月，征西將軍皮豹子等大破劉義隆將於樂鄉，擒其將王奐之、王長卿等。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, the Western Campaign General Pi Baozi and others routed the generals of Liu Yilong at Lexiang and captured their generals Wang Huanzhi, Wang Changqing, and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year, Western Campaign General Pi Baozi and others inflicted a great defeat on Liu Yilong's generals at Lexiang, capturing Wang Huanzhi, Wang Changqing, and other commanders.

sentences.zh: 五年五月甲辰，月犯心後星。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year, on jiachen, the moon trespassed against the posterior star of Heart.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fifth year, on jiachen, the moon trespassed against the posterior star of the Heart asterism.

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the sixth year, the moon trespassed against Heart.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the sixth year, the moon trespassed against the Heart asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "There will be a fallen state."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "A kingdom will perish."

sentences.zh: 是月，征西大將軍、高涼王那討吐谷渾慕利延於陰平。

translations.literal: In that month, the Western Campaign Grand General and Prince of Gaoliang Na campaigned against Tuyuhun Muli Yan at Yinping.
translations.idiomatic: That same month, Western Campaign Grand General and Prince of Gaoliang Na marched against Tuyuhun Muli Yan at Yinping.

sentences.zh: 軍到曼頭城，慕利延驅其部落西渡流沙，那急追之，故西秦王慕璝世子被囊逆軍距戰，那擊破之。

translations.literal: When the army reached Mantou City, Muli Yan drove his tribes west across the drifting sands; Na pressed the pursuit closely, and the heir of the former Western Qin king Murong Gui, Peinang, led troops to oppose the army and give battle; Na defeated and broke them.
translations.idiomatic: When the army reached Mantou City, Muli Yan drove his tribes west across the drifting sands. Na pressed hard in pursuit; Peinang, heir of the former Western Qin king Murong Gui, turned to meet the army in battle, but Na routed him.

translations.literal: Muli Yan then entered Khotan going west.
translations.idiomatic: Muli Yan then fled west into Khotan.

sentences.zh: 七年八月癸卯，月犯熒惑，又犯軒轅。

translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the seventh year, on guimao, the moon trespassed against Mars and also against the Chariot Axle asterism.

translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, the moon trespassed against the Chariot Axle asterism.

translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the ninth year, the moon trespassed against Jupiter.

translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eleventh year, on jiazi, the moon entered the Forest of Feathers guard.

translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Tai'an 4, on jiwei, during the reign of Gaozong, the moon entered the Supreme Subtlety enclosure and trespassed against the western rampart.

translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the moon trespassed against the Root asterism.

translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "High ministers will face grave concern."

sentences.zh: 和平二年四月，侍中、征東大將軍、河東王閭毗薨。

translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Heping 2, Palace Attendant, Eastern Campaign Grand General, and Prince of Hedong Lu Pi passed away.

translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuzi, the moon trespassed against the anterior star of the Heart asterism.

translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year, on renyin, the moon trespassed against the posterior star of the Heart asterism.

translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, the moon trespassed against the Weeping Star.

translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourth year, the moon occulted the Chariot Axle asterism and the Female Attendant star.

sentences.zh: 五年二月甲申，月入南斗魁中，犯第三星。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year, on jiashen, the moon entered the bowl of the Southern Dipper and trespassed against the third star.

translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the moon trespassed against the right horn of the Chariot Axle asterism.

translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Tian'an 1, on jiachen, during the reign of Xianzu, the moon trespassed against the Eastern Well asterism.

translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on guisi, the moon occulted the Eastern Well asterism.

translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Huangxing 1, on bingchen, the moon trespassed against the third star at the eastern end of the northern axle of the Eastern Well asterism.

translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinyou, the moon eclipsed the second star on the southern axle of the Eastern Well asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "A general will die."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "A general will die."

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year, the Minister of Works and Duke of Pingchang He Qinu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year, Minister of Works and Duke of Pingchang He Qinu passed away.

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on guisi, the moon was eclipsed in Shen.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on guisi, the moon was eclipsed while in the Three Stars asterism.

sentences.zh: 二年四月丙辰，月犯牽牛中星。

translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year, on bingchen, the moon trespassed against the central star of the Ox Leader asterism.

translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the third year, on yiyou, the moon trespassed against the Root asterism.

sentences.zh: 五年七月辛巳，月犯東井。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifth year, on xinsi, the moon trespassed against Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year, on xinsi, the moon trespassed against the Eastern Well asterism.

sentences.zh: 高祖延興元年十月庚子，月入畢口。

translations.literal: In Gaozu’s first year of Yanxing, in the tenth month, on gengzi, the moon entered the mouth of Bi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the tenth month of Gaozu’s Yanxing 1, the moon entered the mouth of Bi.

translations.literal: The prognostication said, “There will be an amnesty.”
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read as: “There will be an amnesty.”

sentences.zh: 二年正月乙卯，曲赦京師及河西，南至秦涇，西至枹罕，北至涼州及諸鎮。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year, on yimao, there was a special amnesty for the capital and Hexi, south to Qin and Jing, west to Fuhan, and north to Liangzhou and the various garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the first month of the second year, a special amnesty was granted for the capital and Hexi, extending south to Qin and Jing, west to Fuhan, and north to Liangzhou and the various garrisons.

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year, on renxu, the moon trespassed against Net.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year, on renxu, the moon trespassed against the Net asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "The Son of Heaven will apply the law."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "The emperor will enforce the law."

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳，統萬鎮將、河間王閭虎皮坐貪殘賜死。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on xinsi, the Tongwan garrison commander and Prince of Hejian Lu Hupi, convicted of greed and cruelty, was sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinsi, Tongwan garrison commander and Prince of Hejian Lu Hupi was convicted of greed and cruelty and ordered to commit suicide.

translations.literal: Commentary: The Basic Annals in Fascicle 7, Part 1, record the death of Lu Hupi on wushen, the twenty-eighth day of the ninth month of Yanxing 2; in that year the ninth month began on gengchen, xinsi being the second day and wushen the twenty-eighth; the annals record "On xinsi the imperial carriage returned to the palace" immediately before this entry—here the day stem-branch from the preceding annal entry was mistakenly taken as the day of Lu Hupi's execution.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial note: The Basic Annals place Lu Hupi's death on wushen, the twenty-eighth of the ninth month in Yanxing 2—not on xinsi the second. The text here appears to have taken the day stem-branch from the preceding annal entry by mistake.

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on bingzi, the moon trespassed against Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on bingzi, the moon trespassed against the Eastern Well asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "There will be water."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "There will be flooding."

sentences.zh: 是年，以州鎮十一水旱，免民田租，開倉賑恤。

translations.literal: In that year, because eleven provinces and garrisons suffered flood and drought, the people's field rents were remitted and granaries were opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That year, flood and drought struck eleven provinces and garrisons; field rents were waived and granaries opened to relieve the people.

translations.literal: On gengzi, the moon trespassed against the northern axle of Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the moon trespassed against the northern axle of the Eastern Well asterism.

translations.literal: Commentary: For "On gengzi the moon trespassed against the northern axle of Eastern Well"—in Yanxing 2, intercalary sixth month had renzi as the new-moon day; gengzi cannot occur. The day stem-branch is corrupt.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial note: In Yanxing 2 the intercalary sixth month began on renzi; gengzi cannot fall in that month—the day stem-branch in this entry is corrupt.

sentences.zh: 三年八月己未，月犯太微。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year, on jiwei, the moon trespassed against Supreme Subtlety.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the third year, on jiwei, the moon trespassed against the Supreme Subtlety enclosure.

sentences.zh: 占曰「將相有免者，期不出三年」。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "Among generals and ministers there will be those dismissed from office; the term will not exceed three years."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "Generals and ministers will be removed from office within three years."

sentences.zh: 承明元年二月，司空、東郡王陸定國坐事免官爵。

translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Chengming 1, Minister of Works and Prince of Dongjun Lu Dingguo was convicted of an offense and dismissed from office and rank.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午，月蝕在七星，京師不見，統萬鎮以聞。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuwu, a lunar eclipse occurred in the Seven Stars; it was not visible in the capital, and Tongwan garrison reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuwu, the moon was eclipsed in the Seven Stars; the eclipse was not visible at the capital, and word came from Tongwan garrison.

translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year, on jimao, the moon trespassed against the Net asterism.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "A noble person will die."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "A person of rank will die."

sentences.zh: 五年十二月，城陽王長壽薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the fifth year, the Prince of Chengyang Changshou died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the fifth year, Prince Changshou of Chengyang passed away.

translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guichou, the moon trespassed against the Chariot Axle asterism.

translations.literal: On jiayin, the moon trespassed against Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the moon trespassed against Jupiter.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "Famine."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "There will be famine."

sentences.zh: 太和元年正月，雲中饑，詔開倉賑恤。

translations.literal: In the first month of Taihe 1, Yunzhong suffered famine; an edict ordered granaries opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Taihe 1, Yunzhong was stricken by famine; the court ordered granaries opened for relief.

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on yimao, the moon trespassed against the Right Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yimao, the moon trespassed against the Right Enforcer star.

translations.literal: The prognostication reads, "Great ministers will have anxiety."
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read, "High ministers will face grave concern."

sentences.zh: 承明元年六月，大司馬、大將軍、安成王萬安國坐矯詔殺部長奚買奴於苑中，[6]賜死。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of Chengming 1, the Grand Marshal, Grand General, and Prince of Ancheng Wan Anguo, for forging an edict and killing Department Chief Xi Mainu in the park, was sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Chengming 1, Grand Marshal, Grand General, and Prince of Ancheng Wan Anguo forged an edict and killed Department Chief Xi Mainu in the imperial park; he was ordered to commit suicide.

sentences.zh: 五年三月甲戌，月掩鎮星。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fifth year, on jiaxu, the moon occulted Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fifth year, on jiaxu, the moon occulted Saturn.

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on yihai, the moon occulted Bi.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the eighth month, the moon occulted Bi.

translations.literal: The prognostication said, “There will be troops on the frontier.”
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read as: “There will be frontier warfare.”

sentences.zh: 太和元年正月，秦州略陽民王元壽聚眾五千餘家，自號為衝天王。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Taihe, Wang Yuanshou, a commoner of Lueyang in Qinzhou, gathered more than five thousand households and styled himself Heaven-Assailing King.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Taihe 1, Wang Yuanshou, a man of Lueyang in Qinzhou, gathered more than five thousand households and called himself the Heaven-Assailing King.

sentences.zh: 二月，詔秦益二州刺史武都公尉洛侯討破元壽，獲其妻子送京師。

translations.literal: In the second month, an edict ordered Wei Luohou, Duke of Wudu and Inspector of Qin and Yi provinces, to campaign against and defeat Yuanshou; he captured Yuanshou’s wife and children and sent them to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Wei Luohou, Duke of Wudu and Inspector of Qin and Yi provinces, was ordered to attack and defeat Yuanshou. He captured Yuanshou’s wife and children and sent them to the capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，月入軒轅中，蝕第三星。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on guimao, the moon entered Chariot Axle and eclipsed the third star.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guimao, the moon entered the Chariot Axle asterism and eclipsed its third star.

sentences.zh: 承明元年四月甲戌，月蝕尾。

translations.literal: Commentary: For "In the sixth month of the third year, Huan Shuxing, inspector of Southern Jing Province, defeated Xiao Yan's army at Jiujiang"—all editions read "second" for "third" and "Bai Shuyu" for "Huan Shuxing." The Basic Annals of Emperor Shizong for the sixth month of Yanqi 3 record this affair as "Huan Shuxing"; "Huan Shuxing" also appears in the biography of the Man in Fascicle 101 and in the Basic Annals of Emperor Wu, book 3 of the Book of Liang, seventh month of Putong 2. Here "second," "Bai," and "yu" are all corrupt and are corrected accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial note: Editions misdate this victory to the second year and misread the general as Bai Shuyu; the Basic Annals of Yanqi 3 and parallel sources place Huan Shuxing's defeat of Xiao Yan at Jiujiang in the sixth month of the third year—the year numeral and personal name here are corrupt.

translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Shengui 2, on bingchen, the moon stood in Three Stars; halos ringed the Well, Hairy Head, the right shoulder of Three Stars, Jupiter, and four stars of Five Chariots.

translations.literal: The omen was read, "A chief minister will die."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads, "A chief minister will die."

sentences.zh: 十二月，司徒、尚書令任城王澄薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Minister of Education and Director of the Secretariat, Prince Cheng of Rencheng, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Minister of Education and Director of the Secretariat Prince Cheng of Rencheng died.

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on xinwei, the moon trespassed against the Chariot Axle asterism.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinwei, the moon trespassed against the Chariot Axle asterism.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚申，月在柳，十五分蝕十。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengshen, the moon stood in the Willow asterism; ten fifteenths of the disk were eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengshen, the moon stood in the Willow asterism; ten fifteenths of its disk were eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 正光元年正月戊子，月犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: In the first month of Zhenguang 1, on wuzi, the moon trespassed against the great star of Chariot Axle.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Zhenguang 1, on wuzi, the moon trespassed against the great star of the Chariot Axle asterism.

translations.literal: The omen was read, "The chief consort will suffer grief."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads, "The chief consort will suffer grief."

sentences.zh: 七月丙子，元叉幽靈太后於北宮。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on bingzi, Yuan Cha confined Empress Dowager Ling in the Northern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on bingzi, Yuan Cha confined Empress Dowager Ling in the Northern Palace.

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiayin, the moon was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiayin, the moon was eclipsed.

translations.literal: The omen was read, "Armies will rise abroad."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads, "Armies will rise abroad."

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year, the Di of Southern Qin Province rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year, the Di of Southern Qin Province rebelled.

sentences.zh: 二月，詔光祿大夫邴虬討之。

translations.literal: In the second month, an edict ordered Palace Attendant Bing Qiu to campaign against them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, an edict ordered Palace Attendant Bing Qiu to campaign against them.

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year, on dingwei, the moon was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year, on dingwei, the moon was eclipsed.

translations.literal: The omen was read, "Drought and famine."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads, "Drought and famine."

sentences.zh: 三年六月，帝以炎旱，減膳撤懸。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the third year, because of scorching drought the emperor reduced his meals and removed suspended music.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the third year, because of scorching drought the emperor reduced his meals and removed suspended music.

sentences.zh: 七月乙卯，月在昴北三寸。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on yimao, the moon stood three inches north of Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on yimao, the moon stood three inches north of Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌，月暈胃、昴、畢、五車二星。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on gengxu, the moon haloed the Stomach, Hairy Head, Net, and two stars of Five Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengxu, a lunar halo ringed the Stomach, Hairy Head, Net, and two stars of Five Chariots.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，月暈昴、畢、觜、參兩肩、五車五星。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the moon haloed Hairy Head, Net, Hairy Head, both shoulders of Three Stars, and five stars of Five Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, a lunar halo ringed Hairy Head, Net, Hairy Head, both shoulders of Three Stars, and five stars of Five Chariots.

translations.literal: The omen was read, "An amnesty."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads, "An amnesty."

sentences.zh: 三年十一月丙午，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the third year, on bingwu, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the third year, on bingwu, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on xinmao, the moon occulted the great star of the Heart asterism.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on xinmao, the moon occulted the great star of the Heart asterism.

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiyou, the moon was eclipsed in the Well asterism.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiyou, the moon was eclipsed in the Well asterism.

translations.literal: On yimao, the moon trespassed against Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the moon trespassed against Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 三年正月甲寅，月掩心距星。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year, on jiayin, the moon occulted the distance star of the Heart asterism.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year, on jiayin, the moon occulted the distance star of the Heart asterism.

sentences.zh: 二月丁卯，月掩太白，京師不見，涼州以聞。

translations.literal: In the second month, on dingmao, the moon occulted Venus; it was not seen in the capital, and Liang Province reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingmao, the moon occulted Venus; it was not visible in the capital, and Liang Province reported it.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，月在張，暈軒轅、太微右執法、歲星。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the moon stood in the Spread asterism, haloing Chariot Axle, the Right Enforcer of Supreme Subtlety, and Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the moon stood in the Spread asterism, haloing Chariot Axle, the Right Enforcer of Supreme Subtlety, and Jupiter.

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on dingchou, the moon occulted the distance star of the Heart asterism.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on dingchou, the moon occulted the distance star of the Heart asterism.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，月在畢，暈昴、畢、觜、參兩肩、五車四星。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingwu, the moon stood in the Net asterism, haloing Hairy Head, Net, Turtle Beak, both shoulders of Three Stars, and four stars of Five Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingwu, the moon stood in the Net asterism, haloing Hairy Head, Net, Turtle Beak, both shoulders of Three Stars, and four stars of Five Chariots.

sentences.zh: 四年正月戊戌，月在井，暈東井、南河，轢觜、參右肩一星、五車一星。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, on wuxu, the moon stood in the Well asterism, haloing Eastern Well and the Southern River; it rolled over one star at the right shoulder of Turtle Beak and Three Stars and one star of Five Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year, on wuxu, the moon stood in the Well asterism, haloing Eastern Well and the Southern River; it rolled over one star at the right shoulder of Turtle Beak and Three Stars and one star of Five Chariots.

sentences.zh: 七月乙巳，月在胃，暈婁、胃、昴、畢、觜。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on yisi, the moon stood in the Stomach asterism, haloing the Bond, Stomach, Hairy Head, Net, and Turtle Beak.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on yisi, the moon stood in the Stomach asterism, haloing the Bond, Stomach, Hairy Head, Net, and Turtle Beak.

translations.literal: The omen was read, "A person of rank will die."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads, "A person of rank will die."

sentences.zh: 四年十一月丁酉，太保崔光薨。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the fourth year, on dingyou, Grand Guardian Cui Guang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the fourth year, on dingyou, Grand Guardian Cui Guang died.

sentences.zh: 八月乙亥，月在畢，掩熒惑。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on yihai, the moon stood in the Net asterism and occulted Mars.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yihai, the moon stood in the Net asterism and occulted Mars.

sentences.zh: 五年二月庚寅，月在參，暈畢、觜、參兩肩、東井、熒惑、五車一星。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fifth year, on gengyin, the moon stood in Three Stars, haloing Net, Turtle Beak, both shoulders of Three Stars, Eastern Well, Mars, and one star of Five Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fifth year, on gengyin, the moon stood in Three Stars, haloing Net, Turtle Beak, both shoulders of Three Stars, Eastern Well, Mars, and one star of Five Chariots.

translations.literal: The omen was read, "Armies will rise."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads, "Armies will rise."

sentences.zh: 六月，秦州城人莫折大提據城反，自稱秦王，詔雍州刺史元志討之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Mo Zhe Dati of Qin Province seized the city and rebelled, styled himself King of Qin; an edict ordered Yuan Zhi, regional inspector of Yong Province, to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Mo Zhe Dati of Qin Province seized the city and rebelled, styled himself King of Qin; an edict ordered Yuan Zhi, regional inspector of Yong Province, to campaign against him.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬辰，月在張，暈軒轅、太微西蕃。

translations.literal: On the intercalary month, renchen day, the moon stood in the Spread asterism, haloing Chariot Axle and the western rampart of Supreme Subtlety.
translations.idiomatic: On the intercalary month, renchen day, the moon stood in the Spread asterism, haloing Chariot Axle and the western rampart of Supreme Subtlety.

translations.literal: The omen was read, "The Son of Heaven will mobilize armies to defend himself."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads, "The Son of Heaven will mobilize armies to defend himself."

sentences.zh: 孝昌三年正月己丑，詔內外戒嚴，將親出討。

translations.literal: In the first month of Xiaochang 3, on jichou, an edict ordered precautionary measures within and without; the emperor was to lead a campaign in person.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Xiaochang 3, on jichou, an edict ordered precautionary measures within and without; the emperor was to lead a campaign in person.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，月在翼，暈太微、張、翼。

translations.literal: On guisi, the moon stood in the Wings asterism, haloing Supreme Subtlety, the Spread, and the Wings.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the moon stood in the Wings asterism, haloing Supreme Subtlety, the Spread, and the Wings.

sentences.zh: 占曰「士卒多逃走」，一曰「士卒大聚」。

translations.literal: The omen was read, "Soldiers will flee in great numbers"; another reading says, "Soldiers will mass in great numbers."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads, "Soldiers will flee in great numbers"; another reading says, "Soldiers will mass in great numbers."

sentences.zh: 十月，營州城人劉安定、就德興反，執刺史李仲遵。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Liu Anding and Jiu Dexing of Ying Province rebelled and seized Inspector Li Zhongzun.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Liu Anding and Jiu Dexing of Ying Province rebelled and seized Inspector Li Zhongzun.

sentences.zh: 其部下王惡兒斬安定以降，德興東走，自號燕王。

translations.literal: His subordinate Wang E'er beheaded Anding and surrendered; Dexing fled east and styled himself King of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: His subordinate Wang E'er beheaded Anding and surrendered; Dexing fled east and styled himself King of Yan.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申，月在昴，暈胃、昴、五車二星、畢、觜、參一肩。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on bingshen, the moon stood in Hairy Head, haloing the Stomach, Hairy Head, two stars of Five Chariots, Net, Turtle Beak, and one shoulder of Three Stars.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingshen, the moon stood in Hairy Head, haloing the Stomach, Hairy Head, two stars of Five Chariots, Net, Turtle Beak, and one shoulder of Three Stars.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸未，月在婁，暈奎、婁、胃、昴。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on guiwei, the moon stood in the Bond asterism, haloing the Stride, Bond, Stomach, and Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guiwei, the moon stood in the Bond asterism, haloing the Stride, Bond, Stomach, and Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 孝昌元年九月丁巳，月蝕。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of Xiaochang 1, on dingsi, the moon was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Xiaochang 1, on dingsi, the moon was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 十月丙戌，月在畢，暈昴、畢、觜兩肩、五車二星。

translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on bingxu, the moon stood in the Net asterism, haloing Hairy Head, Net, both shoulders of Turtle Beak, and two stars of Five Chariots.

sentences.zh: 二年八月甲申，月在胃，掩鎮星。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year, on jiashen, the moon stood in the Stomach asterism and occulted Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year, on jiashen, the moon stood in the Stomach asterism and occulted Saturn.

translations.literal: On the intercalary month, guiyou day, the moon occulted Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: On the intercalary month, guiyou day, the moon occulted Saturn.

sentences.zh: 三年正月戊辰，月犯鎮星於婁，相去七寸許，光芒相及。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year, on wuchen, the moon trespassed against Saturn in the Bond asterism; they were about seven inches apart and their light touched.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year, on wuchen, the moon trespassed against Saturn in the Bond asterism; they were about seven inches apart and their light touched.

sentences.zh: 占曰「國破，期不出三年」，一曰「天下有大喪」。

translations.literal: The omen was read, "The state will be broken—within no more than three years"; another reading says, "Great mourning throughout the realm."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads, "The state will be broken—within no more than three years"; another reading says, "Great mourning throughout the realm."

sentences.zh: 武泰元年二月癸丑，肅宗崩；

translations.literal: In the second month of Wutai 1, on guichou, Emperor Suzong died;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Wutai 1, on guichou, Emperor Suzong died;

sentences.zh: 四月庚子，尒朱榮害靈太后及幼主，又害王公已下。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on gengzi, Erzhu Rong killed Empress Dowager Ling and the young ruler, and also killed princes and officials down to the lowest ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on gengzi, Erzhu Rong killed Empress Dowager Ling and the young ruler, and also killed princes and officials down to the lowest ranks.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，月在井，暈觜、參兩肩、南北河、五車兩星。

translations.literal: On guiyou, the moon stood in the Well asterism, haloing both shoulders of Turtle Beak and Three Stars, the Northern and Southern Rivers, and two stars of Five Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the moon stood in the Well asterism, haloing both shoulders of Turtle Beak and Three Stars, the Northern and Southern Rivers, and two stars of Five Chariots.

translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jichou, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Wutai 1, on gengshen, the moon occulted the great star of the Net asterism.

translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the moon occulted the great star of the Net asterism.

translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year, on yimao, the moon entered the mouth of the Net asterism.

translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads, "Great armies will rise."

translations.idiomatic: On renxu, an edict ordered Grand General Shangdang Prince Tianmu and Grand Duke Xianwu of Qi to campaign against Xing Guo.

sentences.zh: 四月己丑，月在翼，入太微，在屏星西南，相去一尺五寸，須臾下沒。

translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the moon stood in the Axletree asterism, haloing Supreme Subtlety, the Axletree, and the Horn.

translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the moon stood in the Rooftop asterism.

translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads, "Armies will rise."

translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads, "Armies will rise and a general amnesty."

translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the moon was eclipsed in Three Stars.

translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingchen, the moon occulted the great star of the Net's right thigh.

translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the moon and Mars both stood in the Axletree asterism.

translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, the moon stood in the Net asterism, haloing Hairy Head, Net, Saturn, Turtle Beak, Three Stars, the Sack, and four stars of Five Chariots.

translations.idiomatic: That year, Hou Jing broke Jianye; the people of Wu who starved or fled were beyond counting.

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on dingmao, the moon was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingmao, the moon was eclipsed.

translations.literal: Collation Notes
translations.idiomatic: Collation Notes

sentences.zh: 二年二月司馬德宗譙王司馬文思自江東遣使詣闕上書 按此「二年」承上文是泰常二年

translations.literal: In the second year, second month, Sima Wensi, Prince of Qiao and nephew of Emperor Xiaowu of Jin, sent envoys from the Jiangdong region to the court with a memorial. Commentary: This "second year" follows the Taichang 2 of the preceding text.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, second month, Sima Wensi, Prince of Qiao and nephew of Emperor Xiaowu of Jin, sent envoys from the Jiangdong region to the court with a memorial. Editorial note: The "second year" here continues the Taichang 2 of the passage above.

sentences.zh: 據卷三七司馬休之傳，休之於「神瑞中」

translations.literal: According to the biography of Sima Xiuzhi in juan 37, Xiuzhi in "the Shenrui period"
translations.idiomatic: According to the biography of Sima Xiuzhi in juan 37, Xiuzhi in "the Shenrui period"

sentences.zh: 已出奔襄陽，隨即與其子文思出奔後秦姚興。

translations.literal: had already fled to Xiangyang, and soon he and his son Wensi fled to Later Qin and Yao Xing.
translations.idiomatic: had already fled to Xiangyang, and soon he and his son Wensi fled to Later Qin and Yao Xing.

sentences.zh: 宋書卷二武帝紀中，劉裕攻司馬休之，休之自江陵奔襄陽在義熙十一年

translations.literal: In the Basic Annals of Emperor Wu in Song shu juan 2, when Liu Yu attacked Sima Xiuzhi, Xiuzhi fled from Jiangling to Xiangyang in the eleventh year of Yixi
translations.idiomatic: In the Basic Annals of Emperor Wu in Song shu juan 2, when Liu Yu attacked Sima Xiuzhi, Xiuzhi fled from Jiangling to Xiangyang in the eleventh year of Yixi

sentences.zh: 三月，奔姚興在四月，豈有於泰常二年其子文思尚在「江東」之理。

translations.literal: Fleeing to Yao Xing was in the fourth month—how could his son Wensi still be in "Jiangdong" in Taichang 2?
translations.idiomatic: Fleeing to Yao Xing was in the fourth month—how could his son Wensi still be in "Jiangdong" in Taichang 2?

sentences.zh: 這裏當是誤以神瑞二年為泰常二年。

translations.literal: Here the second year of Shenrui was mistakenly taken for the second year of Taichang.
translations.idiomatic: Here the second year of Shenrui was mistakenly taken for the second year of Taichang.

sentences.zh: 三年正月戊申月犯輿鬼積尸己酉月犯軒轅爟星 諸本「三年」作「二年」。

translations.literal: Third year, first month, wushen, moon trespassed against the Accumulated Corpse in the Chariot asterism; jiyou, moon trespassed against the Beacon Star of Chariot Axle. All editions read "second year" for "third year."
translations.idiomatic: Third year, first month, wushen, the moon trespassed against the Accumulated Corpse in the Chariot asterism; on jiyou, the moon trespassed against the Beacon Star of Chariot Axle. All editions read "second year" for "third year."

sentences.zh: 按前已記二年，不應重出。

translations.literal: The second year was already recorded above; it should not appear again.
translations.idiomatic: The second year was already recorded above; it should not appear again.

sentences.zh: 天象志三泰常三年條稱「是歲正月己酉，月犯軒轅」。

translations.literal: Celestial Phenomena 3, entry for Taichang 3, says, "In the first month of that year, on jiyou, the moon trespassed against Chariot Axle."
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Phenomena 3, entry for Taichang 3, says, "In the first month of that year, on jiyou, the moon trespassed against Chariot Axle."

sentences.zh: 知「二」字乃「三」之訛，今據改。

translations.literal: Thus the character "two" is a corruption for "three"; the text is emended accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the character "two" is a corruption for "three"; the text is emended accordingly.

sentences.zh: 征西將軍金崖與安定鎮將延普及涇州刺史狄子玉爭權 諸本「爭」作「為」。

translations.literal: General Who Conquers the West Jin Ya clashed with Yan Pu, garrison commander of Anding, and Di Ziyu, regional inspector of Jing Province, over power. All editions read "clashed" as "acted as."
translations.idiomatic: General Who Conquers the West Jin Ya clashed with Yan Pu, garrison commander of Anding, and Di Ziyu, regional inspector of Jing Province, over power. All editions read "clashed" as "acted as."

sentences.zh: 殿本考證據卷四上世祖紀上延和二年二月庚午記此事，以為「此『為』字乃『爭』字之訛」。

translations.literal: The Dian edition's textual verification cites Fascicle 4, Part 1, Basic Annals of Shizu, second month of Yanhe 2, gengwu, for this event, holding that "this character 'acted as' is a corruption for 'clashed.'"
translations.idiomatic: The Dian edition's textual verification cites Fascicle 4, Part 1, Basic Annals of Shizu, second month of Yanhe 2, gengwu, for this event, holding that "this character 'acted as' is a corruption for 'clashed.'"

translations.literal: Celestial Phenomena 3 also reads "clashed"; the text is emended accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Phenomena 3 also reads "clashed"; the text is emended accordingly.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳統萬鎮將河間王閭虎皮坐貪殘賜死 按卷七上高祖紀上記閭虎皮之死在延興二年九月戊申。

translations.literal: Ninth month, xinsi, Garrison Commander of Tongwan, Prince Hu of Hejian, was executed for greed and cruelty. Fascicle 7, Part 1, Basic Annals of Gaozu records Hu Pipi's death in the ninth month of Yanxing 2, on wushen.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, xinsi, Garrison Commander of Tongwan, Prince Hu of Hejian, was executed for greed and cruelty. Fascicle 7, Part 1, Basic Annals of Gaozu records Hu Pipi's death in the ninth month of Yanxing 2, on wushen.

sentences.zh: 是年九月庚辰朔，辛巳是二日，戊申是二十八日。

translations.literal: That year the ninth month began on gengchen; xinsi is the second day and wushen the twenty-eighth.
translations.idiomatic: That year the ninth month began on gengchen; xinsi is the second day and wushen the twenty-eighth.

sentences.zh: 紀於此條前即記「辛巳，車駕還宮」。

translations.literal: The annals record "On xinsi, the imperial carriage returned to the palace" immediately before this entry.
translations.idiomatic: The annals record "On xinsi, the imperial carriage returned to the palace" immediately before this entry.

sentences.zh: 這裏當是誤以紀文前條的日干當閭虎皮「賜死」這天的日干。

translations.literal: Here the day stem-branch from the preceding annal entry was mistakenly taken as the day of Hu Pipi's "execution."
translations.idiomatic: Here the day stem-branch from the preceding annal entry was mistakenly taken as the day of Hu Pipi's "execution."

sentences.zh: 庚子月犯東井北轅 按延興二年閏六月壬子朔，無庚子，當有訛字。

translations.literal: On gengzi, the moon trespassed against the northern axle of Eastern Well. In Yanxing 2 the intercalary sixth month began on renzi; there is no gengzi—there must be a corrupt character.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the moon trespassed against the northern axle of Eastern Well. In Yanxing 2 the intercalary sixth month began on renzi; there is no gengzi—there must be a corrupt character.

sentences.zh: 安成王萬安國坐矯詔殺部長奚買奴於苑中 按卷七上高祖紀上承明元年六月、卷二九奚斤傳附見買奴、卷三四萬安國傳

translations.literal: Prince Wan'an of Ancheng was executed for forging an edict and killing Department Chief Xi Mainu in the park. Fascicle 7, Part 1, Basic Annals of Gaozu, sixth month of Chengming 1; Fascicle 29, biography of Xi Jin with mention of Mainu; Fascicle 34, biography of Wan An'guo
translations.idiomatic: Prince Wan'an of Ancheng was executed for forging an edict and killing Department Chief Xi Mainu in the park. Fascicle 7, Part 1, Basic Annals of Gaozu, sixth month of Chengming 1; Fascicle 29, biography of Xi Jin with mention of Mainu; Fascicle 34, biography of Wan An'guo

translations.literal: 〈Supplement〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Supplement〉

sentences.zh: 都作「神部長奚買奴」，這裏「部長」上當脫「神」字。

translations.literal: all read "Spirit Department Chief Xi Mainu"; the character "Spirit" is missing here before "Department Chief."
translations.idiomatic: all read "Spirit Department Chief Xi Mainu"; the character "Spirit" is missing here before "Department Chief."

sentences.zh: 七月癸未月犯心 志三在太和三年七月丁未。

translations.literal: Seventh month, guiwei, moon trespassed against the Heart asterism. Celestial Phenomena 3 places this in the seventh month of Taihe 3, on dingwei.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, guiwei, the moon trespassed against the Heart asterism. Celestial Phenomena 3 places this in the seventh month of Taihe 3, on dingwei.

sentences.zh: 按志三記月變大抵即採自志二。

translations.literal: Celestial Phenomena 3 records lunar changes largely drawn from Celestial Phenomena 2.
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Phenomena 3 records lunar changes largely drawn from Celestial Phenomena 2.

sentences.zh: 是年七月辛丑朔，丁未是七日，無癸未。

translations.literal: That year the seventh month began on xinchou; dingwei is the seventh day—there is no guiwei.
translations.idiomatic: That year the seventh month began on xinchou; dingwei is the seventh day—there is no guiwei.

sentences.zh: 這裏「癸未」當是「丁未」之訛。

translations.literal: Here "guiwei" should be a corruption for "dingwei."
translations.idiomatic: Here "guiwei" should be a corruption for "dingwei."

sentences.zh: 東井北河北河 殿本考證云：「兩『北河』字，其一必『南河』之訛也，或重出。」

translations.literal: Eastern Well, Northern River, Northern River. The Dian edition's textual verification says: "Of the two characters 'Northern River,' one must be a corruption for 'Southern River,' or one is duplicated."
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Well, Northern River, Northern River. The Dian edition's textual verification says: "Of the two characters 'Northern River,' one must be a corruption for 'Southern River,' or one is duplicated."

sentences.zh: 按志三太和五年條下注作「東井、軒轅、北河」，疑上「北河」字本當作「軒轅」，涉下「北河」而訛。

translations.literal: Celestial Phenomena 3, note to the Taihe 5 entry, reads "Eastern Well, Chariot Axle, Northern River"; the upper "Northern River" probably should read "Chariot Axle," corrupted through the following "Northern River."
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Phenomena 3, note to the Taihe 5 entry, reads "Eastern Well, Chariot Axle, Northern River"; the upper "Northern River" probably should read "Chariot Axle," corrupted through the following "Northern River."

sentences.zh: 六年正月任城王雲薨 按卷七上高祖紀上，雲死在五年四月，卷一九中雲本傳也說他死於太和五年。

translations.literal: Sixth year, first month, Prince Yun of Rencheng died. Fascicle 7, Part 1, Basic Annals of Gaozu: Yun died in the fourth month of the fifth year; Fascicle 19, middle, Yun's biography also says he died in Taihe 5.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth year, first month, Prince Yun of Rencheng died. Fascicle 7, Part 1, Basic Annals of Gaozu: Yun died in the fourth month of the fifth year; Fascicle 19, middle, Yun's biography also says he died in Taihe 5.

translations.literal: Both year and month recorded here are wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Both year and month recorded here are wrong.

sentences.zh: 二十年七月廢皇后馮氏 諸本「七月」作「十月」。

translations.literal: Twentieth year, seventh month, Empress Feng was deposed. All editions read "seventh month" as "tenth month."
translations.idiomatic: Twentieth year, seventh month, Empress Feng was deposed. All editions read "seventh month" as "tenth month."

sentences.zh: 按卷七下高祖紀下，事在是年七月。

translations.literal: Fascicle 7, Part 2, Basic Annals of Gaozu, places the event in the seventh month of that year.
translations.idiomatic: Fascicle 7, Part 2, Basic Annals of Gaozu, places the event in the seventh month of that year.

sentences.zh: 天象志四太和十八年條也在「七月」。

translations.literal: Celestial Phenomena 4, Taihe 18 entry, also has "seventh month."
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Phenomena 4, Taihe 18 entry, also has "seventh month."

sentences.zh: 這裏「十」字乃「七」之訛，今據改。

translations.literal: Here the character "ten" is a corruption for "seven"; the text is emended accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Here the character "ten" is a corruption for "seven"; the text is emended accordingly.

sentences.zh: 二十年二月恒州刺史穆泰謀反伏誅多所連及 按卷七下高祖紀下，太和二十年十二月戊辰記「恒州刺史穆泰等在州謀反」。

translations.literal: Twentieth year, second month, Regional Inspector of Hengzhou Mu Tai plotted rebellion and was executed, with many implicated. Fascicle 7, Part 2, Basic Annals of Gaozu, twelfth month of Taihe 20, wuchen, records "Regional Inspector of Hengzhou Mu Tai and others plotted rebellion in the province."
translations.idiomatic: Twentieth year, second month, Regional Inspector of Hengzhou Mu Tai plotted rebellion and was executed, with many implicated. Fascicle 7, Part 2, Basic Annals of Gaozu, twelfth month of Taihe 20, wuchen, records "Regional Inspector of Hengzhou Mu Tai and others plotted rebellion in the province."

sentences.zh: 二十一年二月癸酉，記元宏「至平城」，穆泰等定罪實在此時。

translations.literal: Twenty-first year, second month, guiyou, records Yuan Hong "arriving at Pingcheng"; Mu Tai and others were sentenced at that time.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-first year, second month, guiyou, records Yuan Hong "arriving at Pingcheng"; Mu Tai and others were sentenced at that time.

sentences.zh: 這裏「二十年」當作「二十一年」，脫「一」字。

translations.literal: Here "twentieth year" should read "twenty-first year"—the character "one" is missing.
translations.idiomatic: Here "twentieth year" should read "twenty-first year"—the character "one" is missing.

sentences.zh: 蕭寶卷直後張齊玉殺寶卷 按卷八世宗紀景明二年十二月、卷九八蕭道成傳記此事作「張齊」，無「玉」字，南齊書卷七東昏侯紀、通鑑卷一四四

translations.literal: Attendant-in-Ordinary Zhang Qiyu of Xiao Baojuan killed Baojuan. Fascicle 8, Basic Annals of Shizong, twelfth month of Jingming 2, and Fascicle 98, biography of Xiao Daocheng, record "Zhang Qi" without the character "yu"; Southern Qi shu juan 7, Annals of the Deposed Lord of the East, and Zizhi tongjian juan 144
translations.idiomatic: Attendant-in-Ordinary Zhang Qiyu of Xiao Baojuan killed Baojuan. Fascicle 8, Basic Annals of Shizong, twelfth month of Jingming 2, and Fascicle 98, biography of Xiao Daocheng, record "Zhang Qi" without the character "yu"; Southern Qi shu juan 7, Annals of the Deposed Lord of the East, and Zizhi tongjian juan 144

translations.literal: all read "Zhang Qi."
translations.idiomatic: all read "Zhang Qi."

translations.literal: Here the character "yu" is probably a spurious addition.
translations.idiomatic: Here the character "yu" is probably a spurious addition.

sentences.zh: 乙卯三老元丕薨 按上不記年月，承上文乃景明三年八月，據卷八世宗紀元丕死在四年七月乙卯，這裏「乙卯」上當脫「四年七月」四字。

translations.literal: On yimao, the Elder Yuan Pi died. No year or month is given above; following the preceding text this is the eighth month of Jingming 3; Fascicle 8, Basic Annals of Shizong, places Pi's death on yimao in the seventh month of the fourth year—the four characters "fourth year, seventh month" are missing before "yimao" here.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the Elder Yuan Pi died. No year or month is given above; following the preceding text this is the eighth month of Jingming 3; Fascicle 8, Basic Annals of Shizong, places Pi's death on yimao in the seventh month of the fourth year—the four characters "fourth year, seventh month" are missing before "yimao" here.

sentences.zh: 左將軍羊祉大破之 諸本「祉」訛「社」，殿本考證據卷八世宗紀景明四年正月乙亥條以為「『社』字乃『祉』字之訛」。

translations.literal: Left General Yang Zhi routed them decisively. All editions corrupt "Zhi" to "She"; the Dian edition's textual verification, citing Fascicle 8, Basic Annals of Shizong, first month of Jingming 4, yihai, holds that "the character 'She' is a corruption for 'Zhi.'"
translations.idiomatic: Left General Yang Zhi routed them decisively. All editions corrupt "Zhi" to "She"; the Dian edition's textual verification, citing Fascicle 8, Basic Annals of Shizong, first month of Jingming 4, yihai, holds that "the character 'She' is a corruption for 'Zhi.'"

sentences.zh: 按事亦見卷八九羊祉傳

translations.literal: The event is also seen in Fascicle 89, biography of Yang Zhi
translations.idiomatic: The event is also seen in Fascicle 89, biography of Yang Zhi

translations.literal: 〈Supplement〉,
translations.idiomatic: 〈Supplement〉,

translations.literal: and the text is corrected accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: and the text is corrected accordingly.

sentences.zh: 戊戌月暈五車三星東井南河北河輿鬼鎮星 按志四正始三年條注在元年正月戊午。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the moon haloed three stars of Five Chariots, Eastern Well, Southern River, Northern River, Chariot, and Saturn. Celestial Phenomena 4, note to the Zhengshi 3 entry, places this in the first month of the first year, on wuwu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, the moon haloed three stars of Five Chariots, Eastern Well, Southern River, Northern River, Chariot, and Saturn. Celestial Phenomena 4, note to the Zhengshi 3 entry, places this in the first month of the first year, on wuwu.

sentences.zh: 按是年正月戊申朔，戊午是十一日，無戊戌，這裏「戊戌」當是「戊午」之訛。

translations.literal: That year the first month began on wushen; wuwu is the eleventh day—there is no wuxu; here "wuxu" should be a corruption for "wuwu."
translations.idiomatic: That year the first month began on wushen; wuwu is the eleventh day—there is no wuxu; here "wuxu" should be a corruption for "wuwu."

sentences.zh: 諸犯罪者恕死從流已下減降 按卷八世宗紀延昌二年八月辛卯詔稱：「其殺人、掠賣人

translations.literal: All criminals were pardoned from death and reduced one grade from exile downward. Fascicle 8, Basic Annals of Shizong, eighth month of Yanqi 2, xinmao edict says: "Those who kill or kidnap and sell people
translations.idiomatic: All criminals were pardoned from death and reduced one grade from exile downward. Fascicle 8, Basic Annals of Shizong, eighth month of Yanqi 2, xinmao edict says: "Those who kill or kidnap and sell people

translations.literal: 〈middle omitted〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈middle omitted〉

sentences.zh: 依法行決，自餘恕死，徒流已下，各準減降。」

translations.literal: shall be executed according to law; all others are pardoned from death, and those sentenced to hard labor or exile downward are each reduced one grade."
translations.idiomatic: shall be executed according to law; all others are pardoned from death, and those sentenced to hard labor or exile downward are each reduced one grade."

sentences.zh: 這裏概括為「諸犯罪者恕死」，既與詔書不符，「從」字也當是「徒」之訛。

translations.literal: Here it is summarized as "all criminals pardoned from death," which does not match the edict; the character "from" is a corruption for "hard labor (tu)."
translations.idiomatic: Here it is summarized as "all criminals pardoned from death," which does not match the edict; the character "from" is a corruption for "hard labor (tu)."

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌月犯熒惑於太微 志四「戊戌」作「甲戌」。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, wuxu, moon trespassed against Mars in Supreme Subtlety. Celestial Phenomena 4 reads "wuxu" as "jiaxu."
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, wuxu, the moon trespassed against Mars in Supreme Subtlety. Celestial Phenomena 4 reads "wuxu" as "jiaxu."

sentences.zh: 按延昌元年十二月丁巳朔，甲戌是十八日，無「戊戌」，這裏「戊戌」當是「甲戌」之訛。

translations.literal: In Yanqi 1 the twelfth month began on dingsi; jiaxu is the eighteenth day—there is no "wuxu"; here "wuxu" should be a corruption for "jiaxu."
translations.idiomatic: In Yanqi 1 the twelfth month began on dingsi; jiaxu is the eighteenth day—there is no "wuxu"; here "wuxu" should be a corruption for "jiaxu."

sentences.zh: 三年六月南荊州刺史桓叔興破蕭衍軍於九江 諸本「三」作「二」，「桓叔興」作「栢叔輿」。

translations.literal: Sixth month of the third year, Regional Inspector of Southern Jing Huan Shuxing routed Xiao Yan's army at Jiujiang. All editions read "three" as "two" and "Huan Shuxing" as "Bai Shuyu."
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month of the third year, Regional Inspector of Southern Jing Huan Shuxing routed Xiao Yan's army at Jiujiang. All editions read "three" as "two" and "Huan Shuxing" as "Bai Shuyu."

sentences.zh: 按卷八世宗紀延昌三年六月記此事，作「桓叔興」。

translations.literal: Fascicle 8, Basic Annals of Shizong, sixth month of Yanqi 3, records this event as "Huan Shuxing."
translations.idiomatic: Fascicle 8, Basic Annals of Shizong, sixth month of Yanqi 3, records this event as "Huan Shuxing."

sentences.zh: 「桓叔興」又見卷一０一蠻傳，梁書卷三武帝紀三普通二年七月。

translations.literal: "Huan Shuxing" also appears in Fascicle 101, biography of the Man, and Liang shu juan 3, Basic Annals of Emperor Wu, third, seventh month of Putong 2.
translations.idiomatic: "Huan Shuxing" also appears in Fascicle 101, biography of the Man, and Liang shu juan 3, Basic Annals of Emperor Wu, third, seventh month of Putong 2.

sentences.zh: 這裏「二」字和「栢」「輿」字皆訛，今改正。

translations.literal: Here the character "two" and the characters "Bai" and "yu" are all corrupt; the text is corrected accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Here the character "two" and the characters "Bai" and "yu" are all corrupt; the text is corrected accordingly.
